verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly describe MCP support: agents can connect to MCP servers to query databases, integrate with APIs like Slack/GitHub, and connect to other services without writing custom tool implementations, with permission controls governing MCP tool use. This directly matches the story of plugging in MCP servers for tool use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of MCP server integration specifically (community evidence focuses on subscription/policy issues, not MCP functionality) and no code example showing server config in the evidence pack.
